brand_notes.materials: Two related fabrics, not two families like Ortlieb. MAIN PANELS on every waterproof-line bag: dotted nylon 420 / polyester 300 with a water-repellent PU resin, 10,000mm water column - matte black with a fine, dense white/grey pin-dot ripstop weave that reads clearly in every studio photo (this is the single most recognisable Miss Grape surface cue). REINFORCEMENT PANELS at wear points (seatpack nose caps, Node/Big Node nose panels, Internode nose corners): smooth GLOSSY black polyester with a double phthalate-free PVC coating, 30,000mm water column - visibly shinier and stiffer than the dotted main fabric, no dot texture. Seams welded throughout. Made in Italy.
brand_notes.webbing: Standard (non-Adventure) line uses solid lime-green webbing for compression/attachment straps, with black plastic side-release buckles. Adventure-series products use the same green webbing but paired with black-and-green woven loop straps; Miss Grape's own copy calls this 'black/green webbing, Adventure series'. The commuting-line Moon/Moon IC use plain black webbing only, no green.
brand_notes.logo: White/silver screen-printed 'leaf plus three dots' mark (the maple-leaf-like Miss Grape logomark), on the main face panel of nearly every bag - reflective-looking in flash photos but not called out as reflective 3M material anywhere on the product pages.
brand_notes.mountFamilies: SEATPACK (Cluster): tapered rolltop wedge, glossy reinforced nose cap, attaches with hook-and-loop straps around the saddle rails/seatpost plus one green webbing body-compression strap; rolls shut at the tail with 1-2 turns and clips with black side-release buckles. FRAMEBAG_HALF (Internode): flat-backed triangular panel hung UNDER the top tube on 3-4 hook-and-loop loops along its top edge, plus one strap near the seat-tube/seatpost end; single zip runs the length of the top edge, offset toward the top; a small D-ring and green webbing pull tab sit at the seat-tube corner. TOPTUBE (Node/Big Node): teardrop wedge straddling the top tube nose-down toward the head tube, ridge zip nose-to-tail; the plain strap versions use one hook-and-loop loop at the nose (around the head tube/stem area) and one at the tail (around the top tube); the '2H' variants replace the nose strap with a rigid two-bolt baseplate that bolts to threaded bosses under the top tube near the head tube - a frame-dependent mount not present on every bike. STEMBAG (Bud): mesh-bodied cylinder cinched by a top drawcord, one hook-and-loop strap high on the head tube/stem and one stabiliser strap lower around the fork leg. BARBAG (Moon/Moon IC): zippered barrel/box mounted directly to the bar on two hook-and-loop straps; standard Moon has small stretch-mesh cup pockets on both end caps, Moon IC (integrated-cockpit) is a flatter box with no pockets, sized to sit between aerobar extensions. BARROLL (Tendril, Trunk 6 Aero Bar): cylindrical dry-bag rolling shut at both ends, strapped straight to the bar (Tendril) or clamped between aero extensions (Trunk 6 Aero Bar) with two webbing straps plus one body strap. FORKBAG (Trunk 6): single-end rolltop cylinder cinched with a webbing loop and buckle, designed to strap into a fork three-pack/cargo-cage mount rather than clamp the fork directly - not photographed in situ on a cage, so mount confidence is medium.
